History of N-Word
# The N-word originates from the Latin word "Niger" meaning black. It was initially a neutral term for Black people. This word has become a derogatory racial slur during the slave trade.
# Over time, the spelling was changed and it was reclaimed by some African-Americans as a term of endearment within their community.
# Today, its use is widely debated. The word Nibba is a sanitized, online version of the N-word, often used in Indian meme culture without its historical racial context, though it's still considered offensive by many.
